question: Liliana’s concert and Wilhelm’s fighting demonstration! If you could only see one of them, which would you choose?
answer: Wilhelm couldn’t do something as fashionable as a fighting demonstration. His sword is not for display, it’s for cutting down his enemies. That’s why he’s Wilhelm, you see. Liliana’s annoying, after all. (Note: The last sentence doesn’t seem to connect to the rest of the answer, but as far as I can tell, that’s what he wrote.)
